summary: Rush Enterprises, Inc. filed an 8-K reporting amendments to two Canadian credit agreements with Bank of Montreal. The Second Amendment to the BMO Revolving Lease and Rental Credit Agreement extends the expiration date to December 31, 2029, and removes a $20.0 million CAD accordion feature. The Fifth Amendment to the BMO Wholesale Financing and Security Agreement also extends its expiration date to December 31, 2029. These are routine credit facility modifications, not special situations. No pricing, stake, premium, or deal structure is involved. Watch for potential future financing changes or strategic capital allocation, but no risk-arb angle.
